## Hypothesis

The baseline engine (current engine without any proposed changes) captures edge on J's anchor days by taking the specified winner trades and managing loser trades to lose less than the specified amounts. The edge_capture is 780, which is just above the OP-16 floor of 771.

## Mechanism

The engine uses the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup for put options on 0DTE, with context filters including time of day, SPY structure, EMA ribbon flip, confluence, no major news, daily loss budget, ribbon spread >= 30 cents, no volume divergence, VIX confirmation, and J's availability. Entry is on level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, or confluence. Exit uses chart stop as primary, with chandelier profit-lock and premium stop as catastrophe cap.
